verdict.rationale: PostHog Cloud runs separate US and EU data regions: signup takes an explicit `--region us` flag, and the MCP server and auth layer route to and store session state in the region you connect to. Self-hosting under MIT via Docker Compose lets you keep data wherever you choose. missing for 10: dedicated first-party data-residency documentation, any regions beyond US/EU, evidence on moving data between regions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
